## Daily Email Digest
Every day at 11:00 AM IST, this workflow reads Gmail inbox since the last run, groups mails by thread, asks NVIDIA Nemotron to triage & summarize each thread, emails a digest to the owner, and handles error alerts in one unified workflow.

**Setup:**
- Attach Gmail OAuth2 & NVIDIA Header Auth credentials
- Replace REPLACE_ME_ placeholders
- Set Workflow Settings > Error Workflow to this same workflow (Daily Email Digest)
- Activate workflow

### **Phase 1: Collect and Prepare**
• Gets emails since last run (24h fallback if none saved)
• Groups messages by thread; cleans and shortens body text
• Promotions and Social labels skip the AI to Ignore
• Splits remaining threads into sequential batches of 10
*Note: Mock Emails node is for testing only and stays disabled.*

### **No New Emails**
If there are no emails in the window, a short note is sent instead of a digest.

### **Phase 2: AI Loop**
• Processes one batch of 10 threads per loop
• Nemotron classifies & writes short summaries
• Missing results retried once, then fallback to Normal with subject
• Wait 1.5s avoids NVIDIA API rate limits

### **Phase 3: Digest and Email**
- Builds digest (Important, Normal, Ignore) per PRD section 9
- Converts digest into responsive, styled HTML email
- Sends formatted email to the owner via Gmail
- Save Last Run updates timestamp only after email succeeds
If sending fails, the run stops, lastRun is not saved, and the Error Alert lane emails the owner.

### **Error Alert**
If any node in this workflow fails, this lane emails the owner the workflow name, the failed node, the error message and a link to the run.
Save Last Run is not reached on failure, so the next run picks up the missed emails.
Setup: attach the Gmail OAuth2 credential, replace REPLACE_ME_OWNER_EMAIL, and keep Workflow Settings > Error Workflow = this workflow.
